## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Jùlì zhǎngzhě suǒwèn dàchéng jīng* (T543) is a three-fascicle Mahāyāna sūtra translated by the Sòng monk Zhìjíxiáng 智吉祥 ([智吉祥](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%90%89%E7%A5%A5)) and his team at the Sòng *Yìjīng yuàn*. The protagonist *Jùlì* 巨力 ("Great-Strength"; Sanskrit *Mahābala*) is the elder-interlocutor.

**Abstract**

This text belongs to the second-generation Sòng translation team, which was active after the deaths of Tiānxīzāi/Fǎxián (d. 1000) and Shīhù (d. 1017). Zhìjíxiáng worked at the *Yìjīng yuàn* in the Tiānxǐ 天禧 to *Qìngyìu* 慶曆 eras (1017–1054 CE).
